paper_metadata.title: Phase transitions and compression properties of Ti2AlC/TiAl composites fabricated by combustion synthesis reaction

evidence.quote: TiAl-based alloy (γ-TiAl + α2-Ti3Al) is particularly attractive for high temperature structural applications due to its low density, high melting point, good creep characteristic and excellent oxidation/corrosion resistance
the introduction of a small amount of Ti2AlC particles into the TiAl matrix to form Ti2AlC/TiAl composite is expected to improve the strength of the TiAl materials with no sacrifice in ductility.
